scope: Mathematical source review plus independent rigorous rational-series evaluation of kappa and case9; not a rerun of all numerical rows.

mathematical_findings.reason: For the same truth-independent randomized procedure under theta and a physical null eta, terminal correct-sign event R has p>=.95 and q<=.01. Since p>q, kl(p,q)>=kl(.95,.01). The null constraint is on any sign report; assigning its entire.01 budget to R gives a valid possibly loose bound.

Pad the full transcript to finite cap with a deterministic stop symbol. Identical policy/randomization/decision kernels contribute zero KL. Chain rule sums observation KL over paid queries; no unbounded optional-stopping theorem is required.

At fixed cos=0,sin=+/-1, one independent observation per arm gives joint KL=kl(A-C,A)+kl(A+C,A)=2E. Starting each complete pair is predictable, so expected transcript KL=E*expected physical shots. Batches or coarsened records do not increase information. Mid-pair stopping, unequal allocation, correlated arms, or uncharged information are outside this exact identity.

B vanishes exactly for fixed PSR coordinates cos=0; therefore the paired E bound depends on A,C only. A constant null eta=(A,0,0) is physical. B generally affects other angles; the arbitrary-angle witness q*=A+B*lambda*cos(x) is distinct and has been checked physical for case9.

The same single physical null witness must bound every queried angle, which permits the adaptive chain-rule upper bound U*E[N]. This review checks its case9 numerical witness but does not independently reprove the complete prior pointwise theorem. For case9 the U information budget at4096 yields no nontrivial power ceiling.

E[N]>=kappa/E applies only when the algorithm actually achieves95% correct-stop probability on this case. N includes errors and cap abstentions. Expected cost need not be integer/even; only a complete-pair hard cap can be rounded to the necessary even minimum4390.

independent_numeric_method.logarithms: Exact Fraction range reduction x=2^k*y with1<=y<2; log(y)=2*sum z^(2j+1)/(2j+1), z=(y-1)/(y+1), with exact positive residual <=2*z^(2L+1)/((2L+1)*(1-z^2)).
independent_numeric_method.arithmetic: Exact rational endpoints; directed Decimal90 used only for displaying them.
independent_numeric_method.stronger_checks: Independent narrower kappa/E/lambda/U/cost intervals lie inside the saved outward intervals; saved power-root endpoints bracket the root by exact rational interval inequalities.

limits_for_sota_comparison: The91.1252% ceiling is specific to fixed balanced complete independent PSR pairs at4096 shots; do not extend it to arbitrary measurement designs.
The lower bound is necessary and need not be attainable. It neither proves16384 is necessary nor establishes a95%-power algorithm at4390.
An implemented procedure with about90% aggregate power is not a95%-power cost comparator. Casewise power, not aggregate power alone, matters.
Current low observed case9 power is not shown close to the91.1252% ceiling; insufficient cap does not explain all remaining algorithmic inefficiency.
Neither this information bound nor comparison with it establishes SOTA superiority.
